description: A motion blur mod that tries to closely mimic human vision motion blur by blending frames together, reducing stroboscopic effects and making motion appear more fluent.

releases.notes:
- Added new blur profile option (Uniform, Weighted)
   - This changes how the blur will blend with previous frames, uniform acts the same as previously
- Added adjustable strength for frame blending and hybrid blending
- Increased strength setting precision
- Fixed frame blending strength variability when samples aren't enough respective to FPS
- Fixed issues with depth and hand rendering in 26.2
- Removed Mod Menu as a dependency

- Update to 26.2
- Improved frame blending appearance
- Better accumulation blur performance
- Frame blending and accumulation blur now includes the hand
- Fixed blur toggle flicker
- Default keybind changed to "NOT BOUND" (old binding will be reset)

- Slightly changed how frame blending works
- OBS output now also records the main menu
- Fixed OBS output issues with some mods 
- Fixed resource reload crashes

- Added new blur method options (frame blending, accumulation)
  - All blur methods used by other clients and shaders are now included
- Added ability to output blur directly in OBS
  - Recording at high frame rates is no longer needed
  - Includes an option for a target FPS output
- Solved translucency and entities being blurred too much
- Limited strength to a maximum of 2 (if you really need higher values, create a github feature request)

- Added support for 1.21.5+
- Improved blur appearance
- Mod now turns off when iris shaders are enabled
- fixed brief black screen after world join
